description: Fix an array-sort-based priority queue that breaks ties by re-sorting on push (losing FIFO order for equal priorities) into a genuinely stable one
prompts: pq.js's StablePriorityQueue keeps an array and re-sorts it on every push by priority alone - Array.prototype.sort is stable in modern V8, but re-sorting the WHOLE array on every push does not preserve original insertion order for equal-priority items once items have been popped and re-pushed in between (the relative array positions get scrambled by intervening sorts). Fix push/pop so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - track insertion order explicitly with a counter, don't rely on array position.
name: add_js_stable_priority_queue
